name: Permit Replay / Mutation
description: Mutated permit parameters or replayed nonce rejected on-chain by vault contract; value transfer prevented.
security_invariant: Permits are single-use, non-reusable cryptographic commitments; any parameter tampering (e.g. amount alteration or replayed nonce) is rejected on-chain by the vault contract.

initial_state.rejection_reason: Vault contract on-chain execution reverted: permit nonce already consumed or parameter hash mismatch.
